cross_cutting_nfrs.name: MiFID II Suitability Record Durability
cross_cutting_nfrs.description: All suitability assessment records (ENT-047), suitability reports, and client instructions must be persisted durably with at-least-once delivery semantics. Loss of a suitability record is a regulatory breach under COBS 9A. SVC-016 must apply transactional outbox pattern for SuitabilityReportIssued event publication.
cross_cutting_nfrs.requirement: Zero data loss. Idempotent event consumers. Transactional outbox for cross-capability event publication.

cross_cutting_nfrs.name: Cross-Capability Async Event Latency Budget
cross_cutting_nfrs.description: Cross-capability events (SuitabilityReportIssued to CAP-005, ClientAccountDataRequested to CAP-001) must be delivered within 30 seconds end-to-end via SVC-102. The review meeting workflow must not be blocked on cross-capability event responses — async fire-and-continue pattern used.
cross_cutting_nfrs.requirement: Cross-capability event delivery P95 < 30 seconds. Review meeting workflow non-blocking.

cross_cutting_nfrs.name: Custody Platform Dependency Resilience
cross_cutting_nfrs.description: FNZ/SEI custody platform is an external dependency for trade execution (PH-075). The system must handle custody platform unavailability gracefully: queue orders, retry with exponential backoff, alert advisor of delays. Partial execution state must be persisted atomically.
cross_cutting_nfrs.requirement: Custody platform timeout: 30 seconds. Retry: 3 attempts with 5s, 10s, 30s backoff. Order queue durability: orders survive SVC-016 restart.

cross_cutting_nfrs.name: SM&CR Advisor Identity Verification
cross_cutting_nfrs.description: All actions taken by PER-057 (Wealth Advisor) that produce a regulatory record (suitability report issuance, trade instruction, Consumer Duty evidence) must be attributable to a verified SM&CR Certified Function identity. The advisor's FCA register reference must be recorded on each regulated action.
cross_cutting_nfrs.requirement: Advisor fca_register_ref must be non-null on all SuitabilityAssessment, InvestmentInstruction, and ConsumerDutyEvidenceRecord entities.

cross_cutting_nfrs.name: Data Retention — COBS 9A Five-Year Minimum
cross_cutting_nfrs.description: Suitability records and reports must be retained for minimum 5 years from the date of the review. Consumer Duty fair value evidence must be retained for 7 years. All records must be archived in the WORM audit pipeline (SVC-111).
cross_cutting_nfrs.requirement: Suitability records: 5-year WORM retention. Consumer Duty records: 7-year WORM retention. Deletion blocked by WORM policy.

regulatory_slas.obligation: Suitability report must be provided to client BEFORE any investment recommendation is actioned. No execution without a complete and issued suitability report.
regulatory_slas.sla: Suitability report issued in same session as recommendation presentation (PH-073/PH-074 continuous).
regulatory_slas.breach_consequence: FCA enforcement action. Potential prohibition of the Wealth Advisor under SM&CR.

regulatory_slas.regulation: FCA Consumer Duty (PS22/9) — Fair Value Evidence
regulatory_slas.obligation: Annual service review evidence must be produced for all clients paying ongoing advisory charges.
regulatory_slas.sla: ConsumerDutyEvidenceRecord completed within 5 business days of the review meeting.
regulatory_slas.breach_consequence: Consumer Duty breach. FCA supervisory risk. Potential obligation to remediate fees charged without evidence of service delivery.

regulatory_slas.obligation: Sustainability labels for all in-scope funds must be displayed at the point of recommendation and in the suitability report.
regulatory_slas.sla: SDR labels loaded and displayed at the start of PH-073 (< 1 second).
regulatory_slas.breach_consequence: Anti-greenwashing rule breach. FCA enforcement priority.

regulatory_slas.regulation: MiFID II COBS 9A — Annual Review Frequency
regulatory_slas.obligation: Periodic suitability review minimum annually for ongoing advisory/discretionary clients.
regulatory_slas.sla: Review must be completed within 12 months of prior review date (or earlier if material change trigger fires).
regulatory_slas.breach_consequence: Recurring FCA enforcement focus. Consumer Duty breach if fees charged without annual service delivery.
